summary: 22 motorists and 3 dogs stranded by a snowstorm on U.S. 285 between Kenosha Pass and Fairplay; Park County and Jefferson County Sheriff's Offices ran a 16-hour rescue using JeffCo's sno-cat, dropping all 22 people and 3 dogs off safely and uninjured with the Fairplay Fire Department near Red Hill Pass
location: U.S. Highway 285 between Kenosha Pass and Fairplay (near Red Hill Pass)
responding_agency: Park County Sheriff's Office; Jefferson County Sheriff's Office
notes: 16-hour rescue mission using JeffCo's sno-cat during a snowstorm; 3 pet dogs rescued alongside the 22 motorists (youngest 6); date pinned via Unofficial Networks dated article (2019-12-06) reporting the same storm rescue 'last week' -> Saturday evening = 2019-11-30, per the run-748 date-pin conflict rule
